observation.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/override.yaml <<'EOF'
services:
  valhalla:
    deploy:
      resources: !reset {}
  streamlet:
    deploy:
      resources: !reset {}
EOF
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f /tmp/override.yaml config 2>&1 | grep -A6 "valhalla:" | grep -A6 deploy; echo "=== streamlet ==="; docker compose -f compose.yaml -f /tmp/override.yaml config 2>&1 | grep -B2 -A6 "STREAMLET_VALHALLA" | head
